title: Urban Alchemy / 1710 North Cherokee Avenue, Suite A / Crisis and Incident Response through Community-led Engagement (CIRCLE) Program / Lease Agreement
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE the City Council direct the Department of General Services, with the assistance of the City Attorney and the City Administrative officer to negotiate a new no cost non-profit lease with service provider Urban Alchemy for the use of suite A of the City owned space located at 1710 N Cherokee Ave as part of the City’s Crisis and Incident Response through Community-led Engagement (CIRCLE) program PRESENTED BY: AU8 lOTO-MARTiNEZ — Council member, 13th District SECONDED BY: vu~~ Buyys MT— SEP 1 5 2026
